Title: Imposes higher percentage of interest and other civil penalties on certain employers or their workers compensation insurance carriers for non-payment of a bill for medical care or supplies
Summary: Imposes an increased percentage of interest from 1.5% to 3%, or up to 5% for a pattern or practice of non-payment, and other civil penalties on certain employers or their workers compensation insurance carriers for non-payment of a bill for medical care or supplies.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the workers' compensation law, in relation to imposing higher percentage of interest and other civil penalties on certain employers or their workers' compensation insurance carriers for non-payment of a bill for medical care or supplies
